data.one_liner: A Dart tool to generate a license file containing all third-party library licenses.
data.what_it_does: It downloads or gathers licenses for all packages used in your project and generates a Dart file containing them. It includes commands to check if pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock are in sync, and supports adding extra or custom licenses.
use_when: You need to bundle third-party licenses into your app to comply with open-source requirements.
You want automated checking between pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock before generating code.
avoid_when: You do not need to display third-party licenses in your application.
You prefer runtime license fetching rather than code generation.
strengths: Supports checking if pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock are in sync.
Allows adding extra licenses or ignoring specific packages.
Provides flexible logging levels (info, debug, verbose).
weaknesses: Relies on specific command-line execution steps.
Limited built-in integration outside of the provided CLI commands.
data.setup_notes: Add license_generator to dev_dependencies and run via pub run license_generator generate.
data.minimal_example:
dev_dependencies:
  license_generator: ^2.1.0

# Run command:
# pub run license_generator generate
